vT543qVJ4NI.title: AN INSANE ENDING TO THE SWISS BRACKET! | WORLDS SWISS STAGE 2026 DAY 8 RUNDOWN
vT543qVJ4NI.note: Rundown of the Oct 31 series. Only three post-game lines on BLG vs HLE game 2 are kept; the rest restates his co-stream or is not draft reasoning.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: With Syndra banned, expects Knight to play LeBlanc or Orianna.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Slightly prefers BLG's draft for its isolated matchups, Gnar into Rumble and Lee Sin into Jarvan IV, but calls it a preference rather than a clear edge.

check.claim: Rumble and Alistar have lost a lot of games at this tournament.
check.evidence: Worlds 2026 games recorded before Oct 31 (Play-In and Swiss): Rumble 5–12 in top, Alistar 6–12 in support.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: HLE still have solid answers: Cassiopeia, comparable scaling and a good early game through Jarvan IV.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Viper's Ezreal snipe on Gumayusi changed the game: HLE limped into the drake fight, and Orianna and Ezreal had prime position to carry it.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: After BLG's Orianna, suggests BLG could add Jarvan IV beside her: Orianna + Jarvan IV combine well and Jarvan IV is good into Cassiopeia. A hypothetical for BLG; HLE took Jarvan IV themselves.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Notes BLG taking Nautilus early, the same thing G2 did against HLE the day before.

check.claim: G2 picked Nautilus early against HLE the day before.
check.evidence: G2 took Nautilus with their second pick against HLE on Oct 30.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Doesn't rate BLG's Ezreal + Nautilus bot lane in this game, and thought Kai'Sa would have been risky too.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Calls Rumble HLE's natural top blind here: nothing else could be blinded.

check.evidence: HLE picked Rumble at turn 9, before BLG's Gnar at turn 10, so no enemy top was on the board.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Calls both drafts standard and good: roughly even, so the game comes down to execution.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: In bot lane, Alistar is good into Nautilus, while Ezreal can farm freely.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Knight carried the game; the one decisive kill he had no part in was Viper's Ezreal snipe onto the Corki.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Reads HLE's Qiyana and Akali bans as banning their own comfort picks, and expects a Syndra first pick to follow.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Syndra is good into both bot lanes BLG could take, Kalista + Renata or Yunara + Lulu.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Calls Caitlyn the correct response to BLG's Yunara + Lulu.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Thinks HLE have the winning draft, and doubts BLG have an AD jungler left that gives them what they need.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Expects HLE to ban Pantheon, the last strong AD jungler open for BLG.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Thinks HLE's K'Sante was the wrong last top pick: it left BLG a free Ambessa, which he rated above the Olaf BLG chose.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Yunara + Lulu into Caitlyn + Karma is a very hard lane for BLG, one that suffers until level 6.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: With HLE on first pick both games, Zeus still ended up on Rumble and K'Sante, the tops he calls the weakest of the tournament.

check.claim: K'Sante and Rumble have the lowest win rates of any top champion at this tournament.
check.evidence: Worlds 2026 games recorded before Oct 31: Rumble 5–12 and K'Sante 5–11, the two lowest win rates of any top champion with 5+ games.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: HLE's first-pick dilemma: first-pick Syndra and leave Nocturne open, or ban Nocturne and let BLG ban Syndra. A double jungle ban 'feels right, but feels wrong'.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Into BLG's Lulu, prefers Caitlyn + Karma; Caitlyn + Bard would also be good.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: Sees no need for HLE to ban junglers in general, but Pantheon is strong into these bot lanes, so expects HLE to take him away.

observations.creator: caedrel
observations.text: HLE have the winning lanes and need their bot lane to win; BLG have strong teamfight champions if they find the right angles.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: After the loss, still rates HLE's draft good on paper: drake and river control, and ending before Yunara + Lulu come online. Says HLE lost the lane by play, not draft.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Caitlyn + Karma leave little room for mistakes: HLE needed a clear lead by 20 to 30 minutes (three drakes, grubs, herald) before BLG's draft takes over.

observations.creator: yamato
observations.text: Hedged as maybe a draft point: Pantheon, Locke and Olaf can still catch a Caitlyn as long as they are not far behind.

excluded.reason: Kai'Sa ban question and 'he only plays Kai'Sa at Worlds': no recorded Gumayusi Kai'Sa to check, caption unclear.
'Zeus is just picking Gnar … pick your counter': garbled; Gnar was BLG's (Bin) last pick.
Reason given for the Kalista + Renata choice: unclear which team's decision it describes, and a claim about intent.
Orianna into Cassiopeia move speed and Cassiopeia's early skirmish strength: said during the game, outside the draft and post-game windows.
Gumayusi 'prefers Corki, Ziggs, Jhin/Jinx': caption unclear; recorded games only partly support it.
'Kai'Sa is terrible with Alistar': champion name garbled in the caption.
'Rumble into Gnar is fine for …' and 'HLE maybe has three winning …': sentences cut off.
Early pushing lanes: unclear which team it describes.
Locke and Olaf punish HLE's objective contests: said during the game, outside the draft and post-game windows.
Camille ban surprise: restates the live K'Sante line.
Pantheon 'misfire': restates the live Pantheon prediction.
Olaf for Lulu synergy: speculation about BLG's reasons.
'Maybe too optimistic': a hedge of his own win-condition read.
Cloud9 Karma record: about his own team, mostly outside recorded games (one recorded C9 Karma game, 83598).
Los Grandes LeBlanc / Qiyana scaling: unclear which game.
'Engage comps have been better': general, not checkable as stated.
